candidate_claim: A legal sampler-service operation can preserve every candidate's marginal forecast law and every pairwise index table while changing only third-order coupling, thereby changing a nonlinear MPC choice.
operation: For each candidate triple, draw two native forecast banks and select an even/odd four-row parity table from the realized bank scores before row sampling.
exact_invariant: The finite-bank construction preserves each candidate marginal index multiset and all three pairwise index tables exactly, while flipping the triple product.

native_screen.result: Attack was lower than parity control on seeds704/705, but tied the ceiling control on seeds706/707; no stable native task effect.

novelty_review.reason: This is an incremental higher-order version of common random numbers and cross-world correlated sampling; the vulnerability resides in the optimizer's joint sampling and argmax rather than in a world-model-specific transition mechanism.

scope: Exact construction and short CartPole screen only; no broad world-model security claim.
